imagePolicy: Use one consistent model and lighting across all exercises; two verified movement-specific images per exercise. Do not mark reviewed until visual and technique are verified.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar and feet firmly planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and brace your torso.
Lower the bar under control toward the mid-chest, then press upward.
keyPoints: Keep wrists stacked over forearms.
Keep shoulder blades stable against the bench.
Use a spotter or safety arms for challenging loads.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above your chest.
Lower both dumbbells under control until elbows reach a comfortable depth.
Press back up without banging the dumbbells together.
keyPoints: Keep feet planted and torso stable.
Keep wrists aligned with forearms.
Avoid flaring elbows straight out.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline, roughly 15–30 degrees.
Start with dumbbells above the upper chest.
Lower under control, then press up and slightly inward.
keyPoints: Keep shoulders down and back.
Avoid excessive lower-back arch.
Choose a pain-free shoulder range.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to a moderate angle.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower toward the upper chest and press upward under control.
keyPoints: Keep feet planted and upper back stable.
Avoid bouncing the bar off the chest.
Use safety arms or a spotter.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust seat height so handles align around mid-chest.
Keep back against the pad and feet planted.
Press forward, then return slowly through a comfortable range.
keyPoints: Keep shoulders relaxed and stable.
Do not forcefully lock elbows.
Adjust the seat before loading weight.

exercises.name: Push-up
instructions: Place hands slightly wider than shoulders and extend legs behind you.
Brace your trunk and lower your body as one unit.
Press the floor away to return to the top.
keyPoints: Maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Keep elbows angled rather than flared sideways.
Elevate hands if full push-ups are too difficult.

exercises.name: Incline Push-up
instructions: Place hands on a stable raised bench or counter.
Step feet back and brace into a straight-body plank.
Lower chest toward the surface, then push away.
keyPoints: Use a surface that will not move.
Keep hips from sagging.
Lower the incline gradually as strength improves.

exercises.name: Decline Push-up
instructions: Place feet on a stable low platform and hands on the floor.
Brace your trunk with shoulders above hands.
Lower chest toward the floor and press back up.
keyPoints: Keep hips in line with the torso.
Use a low elevation initially.
Stop if shoulders become uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and dumbbells above chest.
Lower elbows slowly until upper arms lightly contact the floor.
Press dumbbells back up without slamming elbows down.
keyPoints: Keep wrists straight.
Pause gently at the floor.
Use a comfortable elbow angle.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set cable handles around chest height and stand in a staggered stance.
With elbows softly bent, bring hands together in front of the chest.
Open arms slowly to a comfortable chest stretch.
keyPoints: Maintain the same elbow bend throughout.
Avoid shrugging or arching back.
Start light to control both cables.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Adjust seat and handles so upper arms are near chest height.
Keep torso against the backrest and bring pads or handles together.
Return slowly until a comfortable chest stretch.
keyPoints: Avoid forcing shoulders far behind the body.
Keep neck and shoulders relaxed.
Adjust machine settings before loading.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-up
instructions: Set hands slightly narrower than a standard push-up, not necessarily touching.
Brace your body in a straight line and lower under control.
Press back to the top with elbows tracking near your sides.
keyPoints: Keep wrists comfortable.
Do not let hips sag.
Use an incline if the movement is too demanding.

exercises.name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders and palms facing away.
Brace your trunk and pull elbows down toward your ribs as your body rises.
Lower with control to a comfortable extended-arm position.
keyPoints: Avoid kicking or swinging to complete repetitions.
Keep neck neutral rather than reaching chin forward.
Use assistance if you cannot control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up
instructions: Set the machine or resistance band to provide appropriate assistance.
Grip the bar securely, brace, and pull elbows toward your sides.
Rise under control, then lower slowly without dropping onto the assistance.
keyPoints: Check the machine knee pad or band setup before starting.
Use enough assistance to keep the movement smooth.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

exercises.name: Chin-up
instructions: Grip a secure overhead bar with palms facing you and hands around shoulder width.
Brace your trunk and pull your chest upward by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until arms reach a comfortable extension.
keyPoints: Keep legs quiet instead of swinging.
Do not crane the neck to clear the bar.
Choose an assisted variation if needed.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Adjust the thigh pad so your legs stay securely in place.
Take an overhand grip and pull the bar toward the upper chest.
Let arms rise overhead under control without losing torso position.
keyPoints: Keep only a slight backward torso lean.
Drive elbows down rather than pulling behind the neck.
Avoid jerking the weight stack.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs secured and grip a close neutral-grip handle.
Pull elbows down alongside the torso until the handle approaches upper chest.
Return overhead slowly while keeping your trunk steady.
keyPoints: Do not turn the exercise into a backward lean.
Keep shoulders away from ears at the bottom.
Let shoulder blades move naturally on the return.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet braced and knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle toward lower ribs, drawing elbows back.
Extend arms forward slowly without rounding the lower back excessively.
keyPoints: Keep torso movement small and controlled.
Avoid shrugging at the end of the pull.
Select a load you can pause briefly.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Set an incline bench and lie chest-down with dumbbells hanging beneath shoulders.
Pull elbows toward hips while keeping your chest against the pad.
Lower weights slowly until arms extend comfortably.
keyPoints: Avoid lifting your chest off the bench.
Keep neck in line with your spine.
Use a controlled range without swinging.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support one hand on a sturdy bench and hinge until torso is stable.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip with the working elbow close to your side.
Lower slowly without twisting the torso.
keyPoints: Keep shoulders and hips roughly level.
Avoid yanking the weight with momentum.
Brace your free hand securely.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hold a barbell and hinge at the hips with knees softly bent.
Brace the trunk and pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower the bar under control while keeping the torso angle steady.
keyPoints: Maintain a neutral, braced spine.
Do not stand upright to finish each rep.
Reduce load if the lower back position changes.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Row
instructions: Anchor a resistance band securely around chest or waist height.
Stand or sit tall and pull handles toward your ribs.
Return arms forward under control while maintaining band tension.
keyPoints: Test the anchor before every set.
Keep shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging.
Keep wrists aligned with forearms.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a secure bar or suspension handles and position your body beneath them.
Keep body rigid as you pull chest toward the bar or handles.
Lower slowly until arms extend comfortably.
keyPoints: Keep hips lifted in line with shoulders.
Bend knees to make the exercise easier.
Ensure equipment cannot slip or tip.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with arms extended and elbows softly bent.
Brace the trunk and sweep hands down toward thighs.
Return hands overhead slowly without arching the lower back.
keyPoints: Keep the elbow angle nearly constant.
Avoid leaning your whole body into the cable.
Feel movement come from the shoulders, not the wrists.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Adjust the back-extension pad so your hips can hinge freely.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips while keeping the spine neutral.
Raise until your body forms a straight line without hyperextending.
keyPoints: Avoid throwing the head backward.
Do not arch beyond a neutral standing alignment.
Start with bodyweight and a controlled range.

exercises.name: Backpack Row
instructions: Load and secure a backpack, then hinge at the hips with knees softly bent.
Pull the backpack toward your lower ribs without twisting.
Lower slowly while keeping your trunk braced.
keyPoints: Ensure the bag and straps are securely fastened.
Keep the back neutral and hips steady.
Use lighter contents if you need momentum.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit upright with dumbbells at shoulder height
Press weights overhead through a comfortable range
Lower slowly to shoulder level
keyPoints: Keep ribs stacked over pelvis
Move slowly and stop if you feel sharp pain.
Use a load or range you can control.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at shoulders
Brace trunk and press overhead
Lower slowly without leaning back
keyPoints: Avoid arching the lower back
Move slowly and stop if you feel sharp pain.
Use a load or range you can control.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with bar at upper chest and hands just outside shoulders

Return bar to upper chest under control
keyPoints: Keep wrists stacked and avoid excessive back arch
Move slowly and stop if you feel sharp pain.
Use a load or range you can control.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
